hero.headline: Your look. Your moment.
hero.body: The gown for prom, the fit for the party, and the piece you did not know you were looking for. Come find it in the pink store on West Third.
hero.imageAlt: A champagne satin corset gown at the front of The Showroom Boutique, with purple, blue and red gowns down the aisle behind it

promBand.heading: The gown for the night you will remember.
promBand.body: Spring is the season here, and the best dresses go early. Bring your people, take your time, and let Linda help you find the one. No two girls should walk in wearing the same dress.
promBand.alt: A black beaded mermaid gown with a full tulle train on a mannequin, centered in the boutique aisle
